findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "plugin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notice_record, search_dibbs, search_doge_payments, search_amtrak, search_mcc_forecast, search_sole_source, search_nbrc_grants, search_grants_gov · Private data: search_open_notices, list_awards_by_period_end, get_notice_record, compare_notice_record_versions, list_reported_subawards, find_likely_recompetes, get_recompete_detail, get_recompete_calendar, search_open_grants, get_grant_record, search_award_history, search_cancelled_contracts, search_subawards, find_teaming_partners, search_cancelled_grants, search_cancelled_leases, search_dibbs, search_doge_payments, search_amtrak, search_mcc, search_mcc_forecast, get_protest_history, search_sole_source, search_denali, search_ustda, search_fdic, search_nbrc_grants, search_dra_grants, search_grants_gov, get_far_clause, search_federal_register, search_ota_awards, search_opportunities, explain_policy_boundary, get_record, check_risk, find_partners, research, manage_watchlist · Public sink: get_notice_record, search_mcc_forecast, get_protest_history, search_sole_source, explain_policy_boundary, get_record, analyze_market, check_risk, research, get_brief · Destructive: search_open_notices, list_awards_by_period_end, get_notice_record, compare_notice_record_versions, list_reported_subawards, search_sole_source.
